assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: single clean 2D game background, no UI. Recreate and polish the airport environment in @airport with the same composition: side-on airfield, level horizontal runway, small curved hangars, a control tower left of center, glass terminal right of center, distant city and layered pink dusk clouds. Preserve the JetX recording's soft dusty rose, mauve and deep indigo palette. Improve the painted 3D game-art quality with defined cloud edges, convincing atmospheric depth, elegant glass reflections, warm amber airport beacons and very subtle runway edge lights. Buildings are modest in scale at the horizon 55 percent down the image, never foreground skyscrapers. The lower 40 percent is spacious dark indigo tarmac with a subtle horizontal dashed runway line, naturally grading to near black at bottom for game controls. Keep center clear for a separately drawn yellow plane and white multiplier. Orthographic side view, no vanishing-point road. No aircraft, people, text, logos, numbers, buttons, HUD or watermark. One continuous full-bleed environment.

Elegant restrained colors rather than saturated neon. No aircraft, people, parachutes, text, symbols, logos, buttons, interface, borders or watermark. One standalone full-bleed landscape.
